method: Case-sensitive evidence matching across every raw string leaf after whitespace collapse; frozen source segments independently verified against raw fields. Cross-segment quotations are mapped as ordered fragments, not reported as complete single-field matches. Counts include each claim once per contributing field/type, including cross-segment fragments; columns are not additive. Exclusive means no other field/type contributes to the quote. All indices and character offsets are zero-based; end offsets are exclusive.
